answer: Address-activity payout gate. Each identity must route rewards to a unique payout address that has held a minimum balance and made one transaction daily for 30 days; younger addresses are rejected. An attacker must fund and transact from every clone for the full period, paying per-address fees and idle upkeep that exceed one expected reward, making each marginal clone strictly negative-EV. A garden of dormant clones earns nothing. An opal marker in the public ledger records the 30-day status. The threshold and fees are published on the terrace dashboard.
